label: EXPLORATORY; 012 Stage E generation (design 012E §3-§4)
prompt_text: Write 24 short factual two-hop prompts about well-known facts that most adults know, in exactly this format: "Fact: The <relation> of <clue> is". The <clue> must describe "{c}" unambiguously, using a famous and unmistakable fact, without naming it, and the next word after "is" must be the answer. Prefer relations whose answer is one common word. Example, for a different concept (Kenya): "Fact: The capital of the country where the Maasai Mara reserve lies is" (answer: Nairobi). Rules: never write the word "{c}"; use a different clue in every prompt; use at least 8 different relations and at most {max_rel} prompts per relation; every answer must be one to three words, and no answer may be used by more than 8 prompts; do not use any of these words: {forbidden}. Return JSON: {{"prompts": [{{"prompt": "...", "clue": "...", "relation": "...", "answer": "..."}}]}}.
